documents.content: Billing v2 subscription upgrades create an immediate prorated charge. If the saved payment method is expired, the charge fails with PAYMENT_4027. Update the payment method and retry the upgrade once.
Billing v1 subscription upgrades are applied at the next renewal. PAYMENT_4027 is not used by the v1 upgrade flow; contact Billing Operations for a renewal adjustment.
Analytics v2 plan upgrades take effect immediately and recalculate the event quota. The analytics upgrade flow does not create a billing charge or use PAYMENT_4027.
PAYMENT_4027 means the stored payment method has expired. Ask the customer to update the payment method before retrying a billing operation.
PAYMENT_4028 means the bank declined the payment. It is different from PAYMENT_4027 and requires a different resolution.
ERR_AUTH_1003 means an expired access token. Obtain a fresh token and retry the original request once.
ERR_AUTH_1004 means signature verification failed. Check the issuer and key rotation; repeating the expired-token flow will not repair it.
The standard quota is 120 requests per minute. A 429 response includes Retry-After seconds. Workspace and endpoint family determine the applicable quota.
